evals.prompt: My iOS app for tracking gym workouts is running in the simulator. Walk through it like a new user: create a routine, log a workout, edit and delete an exercise. Count the taps and tell me where the UI is inconsistent.
evals.expected_output: Session with goals logged step by step against screenshots, per-screen critiques, consistency rules and a storyboard report.

evals.prompt: Can you do a full UX audit of our web dashboard at http://localhost:3000 before we redesign it? I want every screen documented and a page where my team can leave comments per screen.
evals.expected_output: Browser-driven deep dive with a fixed viewport, report with notes fields and exportable notes.

evals.prompt: We use real customer invoices in our Android app's test data. Please review the invoice flow end to end and count clicks, but nothing may leave this machine.
evals.expected_output: Deep dive kept local (gitignored folder, no uploads, no hosted page), with the sensitivity stated to the user.
